statement.zh: 只有持有前后所立者的条件把一步连到下一步，以不计次序的延续代替逐位跟随。
statement.en: Only a condition holding what stands before and after joins one step to the next, and continuity up to order replaces following position by position.

claim.en: Where the family may change at each step (OneStep.StepRealized, with givers; OneStep.StepRunRealized, without), a sequence of patterns is shown by some world under no condition, under balance and under closure exactly when each step obeys its law (OneStep.step_every_iff, OneStep.step_balance_iff, OneStep.step_closed_iff, OneStep.stepRun_balance_iff): these conditions join no step to the next. Running down holds in its family everything standing before and after its step, and there a sequence is shown exactly when each step obeys its law and the passages continue up to order: at each positive level, as many stand there after a step as before the next (OneStep.Continues; OneStep.step_runsDown_iff, OneStep.step_runsDownClosed_iff, OneStep.stepRun_runsDown_iff, OneStep.stepRun_runsDownClosed_iff; OneStep.StepRealized.continues). Following position by position on one family gives continuity (OneStep.Chained.continues) and not conversely: a sequence of two idle conditions in swapped order runs down on families chosen step by step and on no single family (OneStep.steps_not_run), and a sequence shown under balance on chosen families is not shown under running down, its passages not continuing (OneStep.vanishing_steps). No premise.
claim.zh: 家族可以每步改变时（OneStep.StepRealized，带给予者；OneStep.StepRunRealized，不带），一串模式在无条件、平衡与封闭之下恰在每步遵守其规律时由某个世界显示（OneStep.step_every_iff、OneStep.step_balance_iff、OneStep.step_closed_iff、OneStep.stepRun_balance_iff）：这些条件不把一步连到下一步。耗减在其家族中持有该步之前与之后所立的一切，在那里一串模式恰在每步遵守其规律、且经过不计次序地延续时被显示：在每个正的水平上，一步之后立于那里的与下一步之前一样多（OneStep.Continues；OneStep.step_runsDown_iff、OneStep.step_runsDownClosed_iff、OneStep.stepRun_runsDown_iff、OneStep.stepRun_runsDownClosed_iff；OneStep.StepRealized.continues）。在一个家族上逐位跟随给出延续（OneStep.Chained.continues），反之不然：两个空闲条件次序交换的一串在逐步选定的家族上耗减，在任何单一家族上都不（OneStep.steps_not_run）；在选定家族上于平衡之下显示的一串在耗减之下不显示，其经过不延续（OneStep.vanishing_steps）。不加前提。

hypotheses.zh: 延续只对其家族持有一步前后所立者的条件推出（耗减）；只覆盖一侧的条件没有处理。
hypotheses.en: Continuity is derived only for conditions whose family holds what stands before and after the step (running down); conditions covering one side only are not treated.

correspondence.zh: P79b（工作板，P79 的延伸），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”，回答 laws-of-one-step-complete 的 next_delta。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用）：家族不必是固定的；逐步选定时，把一步连到下一步的只是所立者的延续，不是位置。见整合文档 §103。
correspondence.en: P79b (work board, extending P79), following Ren's ‘move towards 100%’ of 12 October 2026, answering the next_delta of laws-of-one-step-complete. Reading (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): a family need not be fixed; chosen step by step, what joins one step to the next is only the continuity of what stands, not position. See the integration document §103.

detail.zh: 复用模式、条件之律、见证世界与 Chained。
detail.en: Reuses the patterns, each condition's law, the witness world and Chained.

output.zh: 一步的规律与固定家族上的运行。
output.en: The laws of one step and runs on a fixed family.

input.zh: 逐步选定家族上的运行。
input.en: Runs on families chosen step by step.

detail.zh: 一步的规律对逐步选定的家族逐步成立。
detail.en: The laws of one step hold step by step on families chosen step by step.

detail.zh: swapped：逐步选定时耗减而在单一家族上不；vanishing：平衡之下显示而耗减之下不。
detail.en: swapped: runs down on families chosen step by step and on no single family; vanishing: shown under balance and not under running down.

limitations.zh: 只覆盖一侧的条件没有处理；容量与活动在运行上没有陈述；读法是 AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: Conditions covering one side only are not treated; capacity and activity over runs are not stated; the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; no ethical predicate occurs.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261013T094743.528770Z）：Becoming.OneStep 的 311 项定理全部空依赖，其中含 OneStep.StepRealized、OneStep.StepRunRealized、OneStep.Continues、OneStep.step_every_iff、OneStep.step_balance_iff、OneStep.step_closed_iff、OneStep.step_runsDown_iff、OneStep.step_runsDownClosed_iff、OneStep.stepRun_runsDown_iff、OneStep.stepRun_runsDownClosed_iff、OneStep.stepRun_balance_iff、OneStep.StepRealized.continues、OneStep.Chained.continues、OneStep.steps_not_run与 OneStep.vanishing_steps；同一回执覆盖包内 75 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 4518 项定理／6370 项声明审计，22 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261013T095049.338744Z 通过。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 77 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §103；尚无独立审查。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 311 theorems of Becoming.OneStep all have empty axiom reports, among them OneStep.StepRealized, OneStep.StepRunRealized, OneStep.Continues, OneStep.step_every_iff, OneStep.step_balance_iff, OneStep.step_closed_iff, OneStep.step_runsDown_iff, OneStep.step_runsDownClosed_iff, OneStep.stepRun_runsDown_iff, OneStep.stepRun_runsDownClosed_iff, OneStep.stepRun_balance_iff, OneStep.StepRealized.continues, OneStep.Chained.continues, OneStep.steps_not_run and OneStep.vanishing_steps. The same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §103 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.
